_comment: Greenhouse board tokens, every one verified to return HTTP 200 from
https://boards-api.greenhouse.io/v1/boards/{token}/jobs on 2026-09-23.
The originally-specified list (razorpay, groww, phonepe, zerodha, cred,
urbancompany, meesho, postman, freshworks, zeta, chargebee, unacademy,
browserstack, scaler, gojek) was probed first: 14 of those 15 returned
404. Only 'groww' worked. Razorpay exists under its full legal name,
'razorpaysoftwareprivatelimited', not 'razorpay'. The rest are either
not on Greenhouse or use tokens that could not be found -- 48 spelling
variants were probed and none resolved.
So the list below is mostly global companies that hire in India and do
use Greenhouse. Measured at 259 India-located postings across these
boards, versus 7 from the original list's single working token. Each
entry carries its job count at verification time as a staleness hint.
Re-verify with scripts/verify_greenhouse.py before a demo; boards get
renamed and a 404 here silently costs coverage rather than erroring.
About half these boards carry no India-located roles on any given day
(13 of 28 at the last check, and Razorpay's own board tags none of its
postings 'India'). They are kept anyway: hiring fluctuates week to
week, a board that is empty today may not be next month, and each one
costs a single concurrent request under a semaphore of 8. Pruning on
one snapshot would be overfitting to a day's data.
